paragraphs: Rav Mesharshya bar Rav. This Rav lived in Rav Huna bar Yehoshua's time, chapter Osin Passin. See above, Abba, Rav's father, and what I wrote there; see Rav Aḥa bar Rav. But we have not found in the Shas the statement that this Rav lived in Rav Huna bar Yehoshua's time; perhaps there is some scribal error.
